name: Novel
summary: Notion-style WYSIWYG editor for React with AI-powered autocompletions, built on Tiptap.
description: An open-source rich text editor with a Notion-like writing experience and AI autocompletion. Built with Next.js, Tiptap and the Vercel AI SDK; the AI features need an OpenAI key and image storage uses Vercel Blob. Community packages exist for Svelte and Vue, plus a VS Code extension.
contains: Notion-style WYSIWYG editor with AI-powered autocompletions
Tiptap editor, OpenAI completions, Vercel AI SDK
cross-framework packages for Svelte and Vue
